-- This is auto-generated code



CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.CEATSCovid_Tracking_Ext
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'raw/evpopulation/parquet_output',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_Ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = external_parquet_file
)
AS
SELECT
    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://azuresynapse05.dfs.core.windows.net/externaldatasource/inputdata/covid_tracking.parquet',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS [result]

SELECT TOP 100 *
FROM dbo.CEATSCovid_Tracking_Ext;
